NVIDIA (NVDA) vs Microsoft (MSFT): on the same formula, their operating margins are 13.6 pts apart. What does that gap explain, and what doesn’t it?

Latest fiscal year, same formula
• Revenue — NVDA: $215.9B · MSFT: $331.8B
• Revenue growth — NVDA: +65.5% · MSFT: +17.8%
• Operating margin — NVDA: 60.4% · MSFT: 46.8%
• Net margin — NVDA: 55.6% · MSFT: 40.3%
• Free cash flow margin — NVDA: 44.8% · MSFT: 20.2%
• 4-year revenue growth (compound annual) — NVDA: 68.3% · MSFT: 13.7%

Different fiscal years: NVDA Jan 25, 2026 · MSFT Jun 30, 2026. The periods are not identical.
